OUR APPROACH
About Measures Registry

Measures Registry differs from the dominant AI-market assumption. Dominant assumption: AI optimization is achieved primarily through more compute, better models, more agents, and more automation. Measures Registry position: AI optimization cannot be achieved through tools alone. AI systems interact with workflows, roles, approvals, data, outputs, and decisions.
